scripts.generate:cert: mkdir -p certs && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout certs/key.pem -out certs/cert.pem -days 365 -nodes -subj '/CN=localhost'
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install
scripts.dev: NODE_ENV=development concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
